reviews.review:
I beat the last boss (released in early access, more content coming) and had a great time, the game does a good job of explaining what we have to do.
Interesting progression through currency making us stronger the more we play, also having unlockable items with achievements which is good.
In each run we have the option to do missions that will give us more items and upgrades, a concept somewhat different from what we are used to in a roguelite.
Colorful and lively environment, however I did not like the level design as it is unnecessarily complicated and sometimes makes it hard to find certain missions and even the boss (which has a timer to do so).
Wide variety of items which I'm sure will grow even more with future updates to the game.
The movement is one of the weakest points of this experience, being clunky and inaccurate, I doubt it will be fixed.
Overall I had fun and would recommend this action-packed third-person shooter despite its flaws.

I have found it entertaining, I will continue playing to be able to get three stars in the different missions to reach the final boss more equipped. It's visually cute and the design of the enemies is fun.

There are definitely things to like here.
I like the upgrade system and the mission system is pretty cool as well.
It is bright, enemy designs are fairly cool. 
Unfortunately, the shooting doesn't feel very good or impactful. 
One of the characters felt basically useless and even the better one struggled to down even small enemies. 
 It is lucky that it is in early access because it needs a lot of work.

https://youtu.be/NOjhOkPtXtk

[b]Edit: I wrote a second review lower in the text.[/b]

I hope the studio keeps working on the game. The base idea is good but combat is not nearly good enough to play it by itself. Movement feels clunky, the dodge is useless as 90% of the projectiles are hitscan. The enemies are too spongy and shooting does not feel nice.

I will keep watching the development of this game but as of today, it's fairly mediocre

[h1]New review:[/h1] 
I put 2 hours more into the game since the developer commented in my original review and after a few more runs I can see the development is going well.

As it seems the 1.0 is coming up, i think I should update the review.

First, there're 2 fixes I need to comment before the actual review. 
1. Please add a FOV slider, the amount of things spawning on the sides that can't be seem is way too much to manage with how close the field of view is.
2. Please add more options for keyboard and mouse, for instance, please add the option to hold Shift to sprint instead of toggle, or if the game is meant to be played on a gamepad, please a sign at the beginning.

Now, to talk about the game. 

The game is a third person shooter where you have a time limit per level to grind out items before a boss spawns at the end of the time. The roguelike tag on the store page is really a stretch at this point as there is no real difference in builds or upgrades, they feel the same for the most part and the only variable in play is the character and the deplorable which are different types of grenades and turrets.
Talking about the characters, I hope they add more post launch if they don't change how the upgrade system works. April feels way too ineffective in combat overall, her gun is way too slow to fire, the head hitbox in most enemy is no well defined so the shooting feels inconsistent. Rido, for some reason knocks back enemies sometimes, I don't know if it's intended.
Talking about general polish and quality of life, Jumping sometimes works weird, sometimes I can only jump once like I have no double jump and it would be nice to get a ledge grab to assist on movement across the maps. 

Overall I can see the potential of the game to become really nice, I hope the 1.0 will fix most of the problems and the devs keep improving on it
reviews.developer_response: We've just released a new updated that addresses enemy hit detection and overall improvements on moment-to-moment gameplay. We hope you give the game another chance!
